description: This file defines interfaces, constants, and functions for managing file storage backends, including local and S3 storage, within the Mattermost server platform.

classes.name: ReadCloseSeeker
classes.description: Interface combining io.ReadCloser and io.Seeker for file read/write operations.

classes.name: FileBackend
classes.description: Interface defining methods for file storage operations such as reading, writing, copying, and deleting files.

classes.name: FileBackendWithLinkGenerator
classes.description: Interface for generating public links for files.

classes.name: FileBackendSettings
classes.description: Struct holding configuration settings for file storage backends, including driver type and S3 options.

methods.name: NewFileBackendSettingsFromConfig
methods.description: Creates FileBackendSettings from a given FileSettings object, considering compliance features and verification options.

methods.name: NewExportFileBackendSettingsFromConfig
methods.description: Creates export-specific FileBackendSettings from a FileSettings object.

methods.name: CheckMandatoryS3Fields
methods.description: Validates that essential S3 configuration fields are set.

methods.name: NewFileBackend
methods.description: Constructs a new FileBackend based on provided settings.

methods.name: NewExportFileBackend
methods.description: Constructs a new export FileBackend based on provided settings.

methods.name: TryWriteFileContext
methods.description: Attempts to write a file with context support if available, otherwise defaults to standard write.
